rule: Possibility from omnipotence, recognizability from exclusive signs
meaning: Revealing with signs involves no contradiction, so an omnipotent God can do it; only God can give those signs; and, by the open analysis of the primitive RevealsRecognizably, a being that can reveal with signs only God can give reveals recognizably. So every God reveals recognizably. Four open premises; each is needed (omission models in NAMING-VERACITY-BATCH1-CONTROLS).
